new_packages.label: מִינוּת וְחֶסְרוֹן אֱמוּנָה
new_packages.reason: This is the evil mirror of Package 2 (אמונה). The source text contains an independent cluster of evil concepts all sharing the same essential nature: the domain of INCOMPLETE FAITH and its active force — heresy (minut). These nodes are not eitza-connected to each other; they share the same essential domain (the corruption or absence of emunah). The Rebbe identifies multiple bechina-equivalents for this domain: (1) bar amorai = one without complete emunah; (2) the chala/vinegar = the strengthening of minut (התגברות המינות); (3) the atmah = the act of cutting off from the sages (which IS the biyarsha's/emunah-vessel's destructive move against those without faith); (4) the kartalita/argaz = the ruz/anger that IS the container of this teaching's evil pole. Together these form a coherent evil-domain cluster: the bar amorai WHO uses chala (minut) to force down the biyarsha (faith-guard), and whose essential quality is atmah (deaf to sages). All four are expressions of the same domain: the corruption that severs malkhut from emunah.

merge_notes.note: קרטליתא assigned here rather than Package 5
merge_notes.reasoning: While Package 5 contains הסתרת פני השם↔כעס (divine wrath), the קרטליתא/ארגז=רוגז bechina belongs MORE specifically to this new package because it is the narrative CONTAINER of the entire evil story — bar amorai descended to seize the basket (= the anger-vessel), tried to cut off the biyarsha (= use atmah against emunah), and threw chala (= strengthened minut) at it. The basket IS the domain of this evil cluster — not simply identical to divine anger in Package 5, but the vehicle of the minut-heresy story. The רוגז in the basket IS the evil's opportunity. Assigning here rather than Package 5 keeps the evil-narrative domain coherent.

observations:
Torah 18 presents a clean good/evil mirror structure across its five packages:

- Package 1 (שלמות האותיות / Letters-Completion) — GOOD — the ultimate purpose of creation
- Package 2 (אמונה / Faith) — GOOD — the quality that perfects speech and enables righteous leadership
- Package 3 (רחמנות / Mercy) — GOOD — the sweetening of anger that crowns the humble tzaddik
- Package 4 (מלכות / Kingship) — GOOD — the holy governance grounded in wisdom
- Package 5 (הסתרת פני השם / Divine Hiddenness) — EVIL — the unsweet anger that produces divine withdrawal
- Package NEW-1 (מינות / Heresy) — EVIL — the active force of incomplete faith that attacks the holy malkhut

The good/evil mirror operates at two levels:
1. Package 3 (mercy) mirrors Package 5 (unsweet anger): the same divine anger is either sweetened into a crown (good) or left as hiddenness (evil)
2. Package 2 (emunah) mirrors Package NEW-1 (minut): the same domain of faith is either complete (holy emunah surrounding malkhut) or corrupted (heresy attacking malkhut)

The teaching's key structural insight is that malkhut (Package 4) depends on both emunah (Package 2) and rachamim (Package 3) simultaneously — emunah protects malkhut from outside seizure, while rachamim empowers the tzaddik to accept leadership. The evil forces (minut/heresy and unsweet anger) attack these twin pillars. The resolution is the bat kol — divine speech that reverses the word and brings the purpose (tachlit = Package 1) close to the speaker, revealing the World to Come within every letter of the Torah.

Note on Package 5 vs NEW-1 boundary: Package 5 (הסתרת פני השם↔כעס) is the DIVINE pole of the evil — God's wrath and withdrawal. Package NEW-1 (מינות/heresy cluster) is the HUMAN pole — bar amorai's active attack using minut. They are connected by eitza (minut attacks emunah → emunah falls → malkhut opens to foreign seizure → divine anger/hester), not by bechina, and therefore remain in separate packages.
